name: Sentinel Corp Concealed Draw Holster
description:
A low-profile, inside-waistband holster made from thermoformed polymer that custom-molds to the user's sidearm after a single heat-activation cycle. The holster sits flush against the body, invisible under most clothing layers. A passive retention lock holds the weapon secure until a deliberate draw motion releases it.

Licensed for Tier 2 and above, the Concealed Draw is the default carry solution for anyone authorized to bear sidearms who doesn't want to advertise that fact. The holster's thermoforming means it won't fit any weapon other than the one it was formed to.
functionality: Custom weapon retention, concealed carry, single-weapon thermoform lock
what_it_says: You're armed and the first indication most people will have of that is the sound of the draw.
story_hooks: A Concealed Draw holster is found thermoformed to a weapon model that doesn't exist in any manufacturer's catalogue — someone is carrying something custom-built.

physical_description.visual_profile: A barely-visible bulge at the 3-4 o'clock position on the hip when worn IWB. Under clothing, it reads as a subtle contour rather than a distinct object. The holster itself, when exposed, has a sleek, minimal aesthetic—smooth curves that follow weapon geometry with no excess material.
physical_description.fit: Skin-tight against the torso via friction-fit waistband anchor. The holster body conforms precisely to a single firearm's profile after activation, leaving zero gap or rattle. Sits deep in the waistband for maximum concealment.
physical_description.primary_material: Thermoformed ballistic polymer composite—lightweight, heat-moldable, and non-reactive with standard lubricants and solvents.
physical_description.texture: Smooth, almost glossy finish on the exterior. Interior features subtle friction ridges molded to weapon contours. Minimal tactile signature when worn under clothing.
physical_description.color_scheme: Gunmetal gray or charcoal black; some units available in dark polymer variants that match common weapon finishes. No visible branding when concealed.
physical_description.closures: Passive retention lock—mechanical detent that requires deliberate upward draw motion to disengage. No buckles, snaps, or zippers. Friction-fit anchor system integrated into waistband.
distinctive_features: Custom thermoformed profile—molds to individual weapon after heat-activation cycle
Passive retention lock prevents accidental discharge during draw
Minimal profile—reads as body contour, not separate object
IWB design places weapon at hip crease for maximum concealment
Sentinel Corp heat-stamp logo on retention tab (internal, not visible when worn)
physical_description.tier_indicator: Tier 2 authorized carry—luxury/premium security equipment. Licensed restricted item.
physical_description.cultural_context: Corporate security, private military contractors, licensed bounty agents, corpo executives with discretionary carry permits. Signals authorization without advertisement. Heavy presence in GLMZ financial districts and gated enclaves.
physical_description.condition_typical: Pristine or very light wear when new; develops subtle scuff marks and weapon-specific patina over months of use. Thermoformed fit means it doesn't degrade structurally—lasts the life of the weapon unless physically damaged.
